readme:
# Indeed Scraper (browser fallback)

Extract job listings from [Indeed](https://www.indeed.com) across 60+ country sites: titles, companies, salaries, locations, posted dates, company ratings, benefits and hiring signals, with optional full descriptions and company profiles.

> **This is the browser fallback. For most workloads use the primary actor, [Indeed HTTP Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/indeed-http-scraper).** It is faster, runs on 128 MB, supports deep pagination and more filters, and is the one we keep tuned first. Use this actor when you specifically want a browser-based path or when you already depend on this input format.

## How it works and what to expect

Indeed sits behind a Cloudflare challenge that blocks most bots. This actor is built to be honest about that instead of burning your credits:

1. It opens a stealth Firefox browser (Camoufox) on a fresh residential proxy session and tries to load the search page. Two attempts at most.
2. If Cloudflare blocks the browser, it automatically loads the search page over Apify's unblocker proxy with plain HTTP. This tier returns the first results page of each search (about 40 to 45 jobs), because Indeed shows anonymous visitors a sign-in wall on later pages.
3. Descriptions and company profiles are fetched with light HTTP requests, never by opening more browser pages.
4. If neither path gets a single results page, the run stops after about two minutes with a clear status message, delivers 0 rows and charges only the platform start fee. It never grinds for minutes producing nothing.

You are billed only for rows that were actually delivered to the dataset.

Need more than about 45 jobs per search? Use [Indeed HTTP Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/indeed-http-scraper), which paginates with cursors.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `searchQueries` | string[] | Search keywords. Default: `["software engineer"]`. |
| `searchUrls` | string[] | Pre-filtered Indeed search URLs from any indeed.* domain. |
| `country` | enum | Indeed country site (default `us`). |
| `location` | string | City, state, postal code or "remote". |
| `sortBy` | enum | `date` (newest first) or `relevance`. Default `date`. |
| `postedWithinDays` | integer | Only jobs posted within the last N days (snaps to 1, 3, 7 or 14). |
| `maxResults` | integer | Total cap across all queries (default 50). |
| `maxResultsPerQuery` | integer | Cap per query or URL (default 50). |
| `startPage` | integer | Skip N result pages (0-indexed). |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | Add full description (text, HTML, Markdown) and a requirements list. |
| `includeCompanyDetails` | boolean | Add company profile fields, fetched once per unique company. |

All inputs have defaults, so an empty input `{}` runs a US "software engineer" search and finishes in about two minutes.

## Output

Each row has 25+ fields, including `id`, `title`, `company`, `company_name`, `location`, `city`, `state`, `country`, `salary_text`, `salary_min`, `salary_max`, `salary_currency`, `salary_period`, `employment_type`, `posted_at_datetime`, `posted_at_text`, `company_rating`, `company_review_count`, `benefits`, `job_url`, `apply_url`, `external_apply_url`, `is_easy_apply`, `urgently_hiring`, `search_query` and `serp_page`. Field names match [Indeed HTTP Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/indeed-http-scraper), so the two actors can feed the same pipeline.

With `includeDetails`: `description_full`, `description_html`, `description_md`, `requirements`.

With `includeCompanyDetails`: `company_overview_url`, `company_description`, `company_website`, `company_industry`, `company_size`, `company_revenue`, `company_founded`, `company_headquarters`, `ceo_name`, `ceo_approval`, `company_happiness_score`, `company_social_urls`. Only jobs whose Indeed listing links to a company page get these fields; the rest carry `null`.

## Pricing

Pay per event:

- **Actor start**: $0.001 per GB of memory, once per run.
- **Job listing (`job-item`)**: $0.005 per job delivered.
- **Full description (`job-detail`)**: $0.005 per job that received a description, only when `includeDetails` is on.
- **Company details (`company-enriched`)**: $0.005 per unique company, only when `includeCompanyDetails` is on. Each company is fetched and billed once per run, however many jobs it has.

Blocked runs that deliver nothing cost only the start fee.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

```json
{
    "mcpServers": {
        "apify": {
            "command": "npx",
            "args": [
                "mcp-remote",
                "https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=santamaria-automations/indeed-scraper",
                "--header",
                "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_TOKEN>"
            ]
        }
    }
}
```

For per-tool schemas see the [MCP tab](https://console.apify.com/actors/DcNRjqpfo7uDHUnwh/info/api/mcp?build=latest) and for API access in any language see the [API tab](https://console.apify.com/actors/DcNRjqpfo7uDHUnwh/info/api).

## Example

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["nurse", "data analyst"],
  "country": "us",
  "maxResults": 40,
  "includeDetails": true
}
```

## Limits and honest notes

- Anonymous Indeed results beyond the first page are behind a sign-in wall on the HTTP tier. Expect up to about 45 jobs per query.
- Indeed changes its protection often. If a run stops with a "blocked" status message, retry later or switch to the primary actor.
- Company details are only available for employers that have an Indeed company page.

## Related actors

- [Indeed HTTP Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/indeed-http-scraper): the primary Indeed actor
- [Website Job Extractor](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/website-job-extractor): extract jobs from any company career page
- [Glassdoor Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/glassdoor-scraper): jobs and company reviews
- [LinkedIn Jobs Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/linkedin-scraper): LinkedIn job postings
- [Website Email Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/website-email-scraper) and [Website Contact Extractor](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/website-contact-extractor): turn `company_website` into contacts

Questions or bugs? [Open an issue](https://console.apify.com/actors/DcNRjqpfo7uDHUnwh/issues).

events.title: Job Listing
events.description: Charged per job listing extracted from Indeed search results. Each item includes 25+ fields: title, company name, salary (min/max/currency/period), location (city/state/postal), employment type, posted date, company rating & review count, benefits, hiring signals, apply URL. Base charge for all runs.

events.title: Full description enrichment
events.description: Optional add-on charged per job when 'includeDetails' input is set to true. Adds the full job description (plain text + HTML, typically 1000-5000 characters), extracted requirements bullet list, company profile URL, and company logo. One extra detail-page fetch per job. Independent of the base 'Job listing' event —          enabling this doubles the per-job price.

events.title: Actor Start
events.description: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

events.title: Company details enrichment
events.description: Charged once per unique company when company details are fetched
